purpose: Freeze the approved Pilot products, delegated Gateway key lifecycle, one charge per Workspace period, prepaid Tencent fulfillment, Runtime facts, operator workflows, announcements, and evidence levels without claiming unfinished implementation or runtime evidence.
machineBoundary: Six product surfaces including OPL Serve planned_not_in_launch, four implementation owner lanes, two customer products, ten launch stages, and two paused production verification slots.

lifecycle.removalCondition: Replace only with a newer approved launch freeze and matching contract tests.

architectureAuthority.rule: The upstream repository owns target product boundaries; this contract owns current implementation choices, exact prices, and delivery gaps.

preconditions: read-only provider capacity and price preflight
monthlySettlement.retryRule: Debit, refund, provider mutation, claim, activation, renewal, Secret write, and receipt use stable operation-scoped idempotency identities.
monthlySettlement.currentImplementation: The workspace.launch.v2 non-review path, dedicated manual-review recovery, and reconciliation DTO have integrated local fake evidence through debit, pure Fabric fulfillment, activation, confirmed-absence refund, and receipt-only retry. No real Sub2API, Tencent, Runtime, browser, or production evidence is claimed.

workspaceLaunch.currentImplementation: Exact fixed-USD quote composition, one-submit V2 persistence, CAS/lease recovery, strict one-debit balance proof, pure Fabric fulfillment, attachment, Gateway Secret, Runtime readiness, activation, confirmed-absence refund, dedicated workspace.launch.v2 manual-review recovery, reconciliation fields, and receipt-only retry have integrated local fake evidence; no real environment evidence is claimed.

providerProcurement.capacityCheck: Read-only PREPAID inventory, compatibility, quota, and price check before debit; it must not create or reserve a resource.
providerProcurement.currentImplementation: Dedicated package NodePool allocation uses a persisted per-pool FIFO head and fenced short execution lease, persists the exact N to N+1 target and before-machine set, claims only one new Ready NativeCVM, creates one independent CBS, and protects the system Pool/Machine/Node plus CVM identity when applicable. Manual one-month PREPAID compute and storage renewal primitives and readback remain intact; Control Plane autoRenew switching and worker behavior are outside this branch. Live Tencent evidence remains pending.

workspaceRuntime.currentImplementation: Non-secret status, owner-user-only reveal and idempotent rotation, credential revision rollout, and redacted reset receipts are code-complete and locally tested; Runtime SSO, identity-bound Runtime requests, browser, WebSocket, and deployed rotation evidence remain pending.

gateway.currentImplementation: Session-delegated authoritative group read, paginated filtered sorted Key list, full v0.1.162 general Key lifecycle and reset fields, audited no-store reveal, configured public endpoint projection, per-Key Usage, and current-page bounded operator Key counts are code-complete without Key/Usage persistence; local E2E, browser, and production readback remain pending.

consoleFinancialProjection.currentImplementation: Tenant-safe Ledger billing history and Sub2API request Usage/Stats projections plus the strict local Console presentation are code-complete and locally tested without copied fact tables; deployed live evidence remains pending.

perRunCleanup: test Workspace Deployment, Service, and Secret
verification.purchaseRule: Purchase once only when read-only inventory proves that no reusable compliant slot exists; ambiguous or multiple candidates stop without purchase.
verification.productionSmoke: Read-only service and existing-resource checks; no monthly charge and no provider mutation.
verification.currentImplementation: Dual Provider Acceptance and fixed-slot verification code remain available but are paused and do not gate the Basic rollout. The normal Console Basic canary is separate and has not run for the current candidate.

launchStages.business: A mapped customer signs in and sees Basic and Pro with separate compute and storage prices; the internal verification slot never appears.
launchStages.currentState: Canonical POST /api/operator/accounts provisioning and the strict one-to-one mapped-owner graph have integrated local evidence; deployment and authenticated production runtime evidence remain pending, while self-registration and SSO are outside the Pilot.

launchStages.business: The customer sees live Sub2API balance and an exact monthly compute plus storage quote before side effects.
launchStages.currentState: Granular Wallet, Key, Usage, Usage Stats, and balance-history DTOs plus exact fixed-USD Basic/Pro Workspace quotes and local Console integration are code-complete and locally tested; live authenticated Sub2API evidence remains incomplete.

launchStages.business: After read-only preflight, the exact monthly amount is debited once with a deterministic Redeem Code before any provider write.
launchStages.currentState: One-submit durable launch, required-false auto-renew fingerprinting, total balance preflight, debit-first child operations, restart recovery, and replay are code-complete and locally tested; deployed browser and live Sub2API evidence remain pending.

launchStages.business: Fabric opens one-month PREPAID CVM and CBS only after debit.
launchStages.currentState: PREPAID CVM/CBS requests, readback, and pure-fulfillment recovery behind one Workspace debit are code-complete in local tests; live Tencent evidence is pending.

launchStages.business: Entitlements activate only after all billable provider resources are identified and assigned.
launchStages.currentState: The non-review V2 claim, confirmed-absence one-refund convergence, Workspace activation, purchased-or-refunded Receipt paths, dedicated workspace.launch.v2 manual-review recovery, and reconciliation DTO have integrated local fake evidence; live evidence remains pending.

launchStages.business: The customer authenticates to a ready Workspace backed by owned compute, CBS, and a Workspace-scoped Gateway Secret.
launchStages.currentState: V2 attachment, Workspace Secret, Runtime readiness gating, activation, receipt-only recovery, non-secret status, and credential flows have local focused evidence on the non-review path. Runtime metadata/statfs API and Console presentation are paused outside this release; immutable image, browser, WebSocket, live model, direct mount-marker persistence, and deployed evidence remain pending.
requiredDeliverables: owner-only Runtime credential reveal and rotation

launchStages.business: The owner can reveal the Workspace's reserved Key, make a metered Workspace model request, and inspect its customer-safe cost and Token facts.
launchStages.currentState: Wallet, Key list/status, request-level Usage, Usage Stats, balance history, and customer-safe integer-cost projections are code-complete and locally tested; a real model request and production readback remain pending.

launchStages.business: Customer and Tencent periods renew once with debit-first recovery, manual Tencent renewal, and provider readback.
launchStages.currentState: One Workspace-level claim, combined debit, same-ID PREPAID provider renewal/readback, expiry, refund/review, and receipt recovery are code-complete and locally tested. Enabling auto-renew and real renewal evidence remain pending.
requiredDeliverables: unpaid expiry access denial and provider-owned reclamation policy

launchStages.business: Every release proves the real Workspace and Gateway path without buying or deleting monthly Tencent resources per run.
launchStages.currentState: Dual Acceptance and one-request Basic live-QA workflows are code-complete and fake-tested; real Acceptance and live QA remain pending.
requiredDeliverables: one real dedicated-Key request per release

launchStages.business: A release is ready only from merged code, immutable Cloud and App images, runtime checks, rollback proof, and reusable verification.
launchStages.currentState: Security, immutable Ready-Pod imageID checks, ConfigMap-aware Cloud rollback, read-only TKE diagnostics, release tooling, local Console integration gates, and the deployment identity cutover are code-complete locally; immutable publication, successful rollout, deployed browser, Gateway, and safe real verification evidence remain incomplete.
